name: ikemen-vs
description: Highlighting, outline, autocomplete, warnings and a Quick VS button for Ikemen GO and MUGEN files (.cns, .cmd, .st, .zss, .air, .def).

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Running Ikemen GO uses a program path and command line options, which are ignored from workspace settings in an untrusted workspace.

Run Current Stage in Ikemen GO

enumDescriptions: ModifyExplod, StateNo, AnimTime (as written in the documentation)
ikemenVS.zss.nameStyle.description: How state controller and trigger names are written when inserted by the ZSS autocomplete.

ikemenVS.ikemen.executable.description: Absolute path to the Ikemen GO executable (for example D:\Ikemen\Ikemen_GO.exe).

ikemenVS.ikemen.opponent.description: Character used as the test opponent: a name (kfm_zss) or a .def path. Also used on both sides when testing a stage.

ikemenVS.ikemen.opponentAI.description: AI level of the opponent (0 = no AI, 1-8 = AI).

ikemenVS.ikemen.stage.description: Stage used when running a character, for example stages/stage0.def. Empty uses the engine default.

ikemenVS.ikemen.extraArgs.description: Extra command line options, for example ["-windowed", "-nomusic"].

ikemenVS.ikemen.saveBeforeRun.description: Save all open files before running.

ikemenVS.diagnostics.enabled.description: Show diagnostics for duplicated parameters, unknown controllers and triggers, and ZSS syntax errors in CNS/CMD/ST/ZSS character files.

ikemenVS.diagnostics.unknownTriggers.description: Warn about trigger names that are not in the documentation data.

ikemenVS.diagnostics.ignoredNames.description: Controller or trigger names that should never be reported as unknown (useful for names missing from the documentation data).

ikemenVS.diagnostics.missingSemicolons.description: In ZSS files, report a missing ";" between parameters and at the end of statements (let, call, assignments).
